hypotheses.justification: The proof only needs `algebraMap R K₀ ϖ ≠ 0`. Valuations of nonzero elements are nonzero, and `zero_le'` gives `0 ≤ v x`, so that is enough for `0 < v x`. The helper `algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible` proves the nonzero fact as `hϖ.ne_zero ((IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff (K := K₀)).mp h)`. `IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/FractionRing.lean:131) only needs `[CommRing R] [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]`. `Irreducible.ne_zero` only needs a `MonoidWithZero`. `map_ne_zero` holds for the field hom `algebraMap K₀ K`, and `Valuation.ne_zero_iff` holds over `K`. None of these steps uses the DVR structure. The theorem is included only because it is instance-implicit and its type mentions only the argument `R`. Adding `omit [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] in`, both for this theorem and for the helper or by inlining the helper's one-line proof, leaves the statement and proof valid. `[IsDomain R]` cannot be deleted on its own while `[IsDiscreteValuationRing R]` remains, because that class takes `[IsDomain R]` as a parameter. So only the DVR assumption is reported as removable by itself.
